# ShipSealed

> Tested guides and free tools for Supabase security: Row-Level Security (RLS) policies, the errors they cause (42501, PGRST116, PGRST205, "new row violates row-level security policy"), and leak checks for apps built with AI tools (Lovable, Bolt, v0, Cursor). Every SQL snippet is tested against a real Postgres. Maker of Airlock (npm: airlock-rls), an open-source CI gate and MCP server for Supabase RLS.

## Tools

- [Supabase RLS Cheat Sheet — ShipSealed](https://shipsealed.com/cheatsheet/): The one-page Supabase Row-Level Security cheat sheet: the golden rules, the footguns that leak in prod, correct policy snippets, and the test that proves tenant isolation.
- [Five ways to check Supabase RLS — and when to use each one (2026)](https://shipsealed.com/compare/supabase-rls-tools/): Honest comparison of Supabase RLS checking tools — RLS Tester, Security Advisor, Lovable scan, SQL audit kit, RowAttest, Airlock Monitor — on scope, automation, writes, cross-tenant, price.
- [The best Supabase SaaS boilerplate: an honest comparison (2026)](https://shipsealed.com/compare/supabase-saas-boilerplate/): Honest comparison of Next.js + Supabase SaaS boilerplates — ShipSealed, ShipFast, Makerkit, Supastarter — on Supabase focus, RLS, isolation tests, and price.
- [Live demo — the exact RLS policy + test, proven against a real Postgres · ShipSealed](https://shipsealed.com/demo/): The real RLS policy, a real HTTP request as one tenant, the raw response from a live Postgres. One app leaks, one blocks. Verify it yourself.
- [Is your Supabase app leaking? Free security scanner](https://shipsealed.com/service-role-scanner/): Scan your live Supabase app: a service_role key in the browser, an exposed .env or .git, and tables anyone can read without login. Free, no signup.
- [Supabase security rules for Cursor, Claude Code & Windsurf](https://shipsealed.com/supabase-ai-rules/): AI-agent rules so Cursor, Claude Code and Windsurf write secure Supabase code: RLS, scoped policies, explicit grants, service_role server-side. Free, MIT.
- [Explain a Supabase RLS policy — does it leak?](https://shipsealed.com/supabase-rls-policy-explainer/): Paste a Supabase RLS policy and get it in plain English: which rows and roles it allows, and whether it leaks (USING (true), no WITH CHECK, unscoped anon).
- [Supabase RLS policy generator — tested SQL for your table](https://shipsealed.com/supabase-rls-policy-generator/): Free Supabase RLS policy generator. Paste your CREATE TABLE and get the migration: RLS, a policy per operation, grants and indexes, tested on Postgres.
- [Verify an Airlock attestation — ShipSealed](https://shipsealed.com/verify/): Independently verify an Airlock Monitor audit attestation. Client-side Ed25519 signature verification — nothing leaves your browser.

## Guides (English)

- [new row violates row-level security policy for table: Supabase fix](https://shipsealed.com/rls/fix-new-row-violates-row-level-security-policy/): Supabase insert fails with new row violates row-level security policy for table? The 3 causes (no INSERT policy, wrong user_id, no session) and the fix.
- [How to enable Row-Level Security on a Supabase table](https://shipsealed.com/rls/enable-row-level-security-supabase-table/): Enable RLS on a Supabase table the right way: the one-line command, why RLS-on with no policy denies everything, the first owner policy to add, and how to verify it's on.
- [How to write an owner-scoped RLS policy (SELECT / INSERT / UPDATE / DELETE)](https://shipsealed.com/rls/write-owner-scoped-rls-policy-supabase/): The complete owner-scoped Supabase RLS policy set for SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE — with the right USING and WITH CHECK on each, and why UPDATE needs both.
- [Multi-tenant RLS with workspaces in Supabase](https://shipsealed.com/rls/multi-tenant-rls-workspaces-supabase/): Team/workspace multi-tenancy in Supabase with RLS: a membership table, a security-definer function to resolve membership without recursion, and policies that scope every row to the caller's workspaces.
- [How to test tenant isolation in Supabase (RLS)](https://shipsealed.com/rls/test-tenant-isolation-supabase/): Prove your Supabase RLS actually isolates tenants: an integration test with two signed-in clients that asserts one tenant gets zero rows for another and can't insert on their behalf.
- [USING (true) is a security hole — how to fix a permissive RLS policy](https://shipsealed.com/rls/fix-permissive-rls-policy-using-true/): A Supabase RLS policy with USING (true) makes the table public read. Here's how to find every permissive policy in your database and replace it with one scoped to the signed-in user.
- [Why is my Supabase table public? (RLS is off)](https://shipsealed.com/rls/supabase-table-public-rls-off/): If your Supabase table has Row-Level Security off, anyone with your anon key can read every row. Here's how to confirm the leak, see it with a single curl, and close it.
- [Next.js App Router + Supabase auth with RLS (SSR)](https://shipsealed.com/rls/nextjs-app-router-supabase-auth-rls-ssr/): Make RLS work in a Next.js App Router server component: create a Supabase server client from the request cookies with @supabase/ssr so auth.uid() resolves — and stop your queries returning an empty array on the server.
- [RLS in CI: fail the build when a table ships exposed](https://shipsealed.com/rls/rls-in-ci-fail-build-exposed-table/): Turn RLS from a thing you remember into a thing your pipeline enforces: a CI gate that fails the build when a Supabase table ships with RLS off or a permissive policy.
- [owner_id vs workspace_id: which RLS pattern to use](https://shipsealed.com/rls/owner-id-vs-workspace-id-rls-pattern/): Choosing between an owner-scoped and a workspace-scoped RLS model in Supabase: what each looks like, when to pick it, and how to migrate from single-owner to teams later without a rewrite.
- [RLS vs app-layer authorization: which and why](https://shipsealed.com/rls/rls-vs-app-layer-authorization/): Should you enforce access in Row-Level Security or in your application code? Why RLS is the security boundary that can't be bypassed, where app-layer checks still belong, and how to use both.
- [Supabase security checklist before launch](https://shipsealed.com/rls/supabase-security-checklist-before-launch/): The pre-launch Supabase security checklist: RLS on every table, policies scoped to the user, WITH CHECK on writes, no permissive policies, service_role server-only, and an isolation test in CI — each with the guide to do it.
- [Supabase October 30 grants change: what breaks + the fix](https://shipsealed.com/rls/supabase-october-30-grants-change/): From October 30, 2026, new Supabase tables get no grants, so the API returns 42501. The one-line GRANT per table that fixes it, and the bulk fix that leaks.
- [Fix: "infinite recursion detected in policy for relation" (Supabase RLS)](https://shipsealed.com/rls/fix-infinite-recursion-detected-in-policy-supabase/): Why Supabase returns infinite recursion detected in policy for relation (42P17), the one pattern that causes it, and the fix: a security definer helper in a private schema.
- [Fix PGRST116: "Cannot coerce the result to a single JSON object" (Supabase)](https://shipsealed.com/rls/fix-pgrst116-cannot-coerce-result-single-json-object/): Why supabase-js .single() returns PGRST116 (The result contains 0 rows), why RLS is often the cause even when the row exists, and when to use maybeSingle() instead.
- [Supabase "permission denied for table" (42501): the right fix](https://shipsealed.com/rls/fix-permission-denied-for-table-supabase-42501/): Supabase says permission denied for table (42501)? It's a missing GRANT, not RLS. The per-table grant that fixes it, and the bulk grant that leaks.
- [Supabase update or delete does nothing (no error): it's RLS](https://shipsealed.com/rls/supabase-update-delete-not-working-rls/): Your Supabase update() or delete() returns no error but changes nothing. Why RLS makes writes silently affect 0 rows, and the UPDATE and DELETE policies that fix it.
- [PGRST205 Could not find the table in the schema cache: Supabase fix](https://shipsealed.com/rls/fix-pgrst205-could-not-find-table-schema-cache/): Supabase returns PGRST205 Could not find the table 'public.x' in the schema cache? Check the name, expose the schema, reload the cache, then grant.
- [Lovable Supabase security checklist: 6 checks before launch](https://shipsealed.com/rls/lovable-supabase-security-checklist/): Is your Lovable app leaking data? 6 checks with tested SQL: exposed service_role key, public tables, always-true policies, open functions, signed-out test.
- [Bolt.new + Supabase security checklist: is your app leaking data?](https://shipsealed.com/rls/bolt-new-supabase-security-checklist/): Built your app with Bolt.new on Supabase? Six checks with tested SQL: an exposed service_role key, public tables, always-true RLS policies, callable functions, and how to prove it as a stranger.
- [v0 + Supabase security checklist: is your Next.js app leaking data?](https://shipsealed.com/rls/v0-supabase-security-checklist/): Built a Next.js app with v0 on Supabase? Six checks with tested SQL: a service_role key in a NEXT_PUBLIC_ variable, public tables, always-true RLS policies, callable functions, and a signed-out test.
- [Fix "permission denied for sequence" in Supabase (42501)](https://shipsealed.com/rls/fix-permission-denied-for-sequence-supabase/): Inserts fail with permission denied for sequence after the table grant? A serial column needs its own grant. Plus why service_role gets 42501 on new tables.
- [Is the Supabase anon key safe to expose?](https://shipsealed.com/rls/is-the-supabase-anon-key-safe-to-expose/): Yes, the Supabase anon key is built to ship in your frontend. It's safe only when RLS is on, with a policy, on every table it can reach - not always.
- [Supabase Storage upload: "new row violates row-level security policy" (fix)](https://shipsealed.com/rls/supabase-storage-upload-new-row-violates-row-level-security/): Why a Supabase Storage upload returns 403 new row violates row-level security policy, the storage.objects policy that fixes it (scoped to the user's folder), and why upsert needs two more policies.
- [Supabase upsert: "new row violates row-level security policy" with an INSERT policy (fix)](https://shipsealed.com/rls/supabase-upsert-new-row-violates-row-level-security/): Your Supabase insert works but upsert() fails with new row violates row-level security policy. Why ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE needs SELECT and UPDATE policies too, even for a new row.
- [Fix PGRST202: "Could not find the function ... in the schema cache" (Supabase RPC)](https://shipsealed.com/rls/fix-pgrst202-could-not-find-function-schema-cache/): Why supabase.rpc() returns PGRST202 Could not find the function public.fn(...) in the schema cache: parameter names that don't match, the wrong schema, a stale cache, and the grant you'll need next.
- [Fix PGRST200: "Could not find a relationship between ... in the schema cache" (Supabase)](https://shipsealed.com/rls/fix-pgrst200-could-not-find-relationship-schema-cache/): Why a Supabase select with a join, like select('*, authors(name)'), returns PGRST200 Could not find a relationship: no foreign key, a stale cache, or two keys between the same tables (PGRST201).
- [Fix "JWT expired" (PGRST303) in Supabase: keeping the session fresh](https://shipsealed.com/rls/fix-supabase-jwt-expired-pgrst303/): Why Supabase requests fail with 401 JWT expired (PGRST303), why it shows up in server code and after a laptop sleeps, and how to keep the session refreshed with @supabase/ssr.

## Guides (Português)

- [Mudança de grants do Supabase em 30/10: o que quebra e a correção que vaza](https://shipsealed.com/pt/rls/supabase-mudanca-grants-30-outubro/): A partir de 30/10/2026, tabelas novas no Supabase precisam de GRANT explícito pra aparecer na Data API. O que quebra (42501), a migration certa e a correção que vaza dados.
- [Erro 42501 "permission denied for table" no Supabase: como resolver](https://shipsealed.com/pt/rls/erro-42501-permission-denied-for-table-supabase/): Por que o Supabase devolve 42501 permission denied for table (ou for schema), a diferença pra um erro de RLS e o GRANT por tabela que resolve sem expor as outras tabelas.
- [Checklist de segurança Lovable + Supabase: seu app está vazando dados?](https://shipsealed.com/pt/rls/checklist-seguranca-lovable-supabase/): Fez seu app com a Lovable no Supabase? Seis verificações com SQL testado: chave service_role exposta, tabelas públicas, policies sempre verdadeiras, funções liberadas e o teste como estranho.
- [Upload no Supabase Storage: "new row violates row-level security policy" (como resolver)](https://shipsealed.com/pt/rls/erro-upload-storage-new-row-violates-row-level-security/): Por que o upload no Supabase Storage devolve 403 new row violates row-level security policy, a policy em storage.objects que resolve (limitada à pasta do usuário) e por que o upsert precisa de mais duas.
- [Upsert no Supabase: "new row violates row-level security policy" mesmo com policy de INSERT](https://shipsealed.com/pt/rls/erro-upsert-new-row-violates-row-level-security/): O insert funciona, mas o upsert() falha com new row violates row-level security policy. Por que o ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE precisa das policies de SELECT e UPDATE, mesmo pra uma linha nova.
- [Erro PGRST202 "Could not find the function ... in the schema cache" no Supabase (RPC)](https://shipsealed.com/pt/rls/erro-pgrst202-could-not-find-function-supabase/): Por que o supabase.rpc() devolve PGRST202 Could not find the function public.fn(...) in the schema cache: nomes de parâmetro diferentes, schema errado, cache desatualizado, e o grant que vem depois.
- [Erro PGRST200 "Could not find a relationship between ... in the schema cache" no Supabase](https://shipsealed.com/pt/rls/erro-pgrst200-could-not-find-relationship-supabase/): Por que um select com join no Supabase, como select('*, authors(name)'), devolve PGRST200 Could not find a relationship: falta chave estrangeira, cache desatualizado ou duas chaves entre as mesmas tabelas (PGRST201).
- [Erro "JWT expired" (PGRST303) no Supabase: como manter a sessão renovada](https://shipsealed.com/pt/rls/erro-jwt-expired-pgrst303-supabase/): Por que as requisições ao Supabase falham com 401 JWT expired (PGRST303), por que isso aparece no código do servidor e depois que o notebook hiberna, e como manter a sessão renovada com @supabase/ssr.

## Open source

- [airlock-rls on GitHub](https://github.com/mateuszingano/airlock-rls): CLI and GitHub Action that fails the build on tables without RLS, always-true policies, tenant leaks, public buckets and risky SECURITY DEFINER functions.
- [airlock-rls-mcp on GitHub](https://github.com/mateuszingano/airlock-rls-mcp): MCP server so Cursor, Claude Code or any MCP client can run the same checks while building.
